name: P1 drift with the episodic memory's sparse separator (memory_fan_in 4 and 2) against the dense founder
credit: Will Glynn, cadence-teachers EXP-46 and EXP-47 (https://github.com/WGlynn/cadence-teachers): the per-state reading beside whole-chain success, and the two continuations from one taught brain read at 10, 20, 40 and 80 episodes alone
question: On reading 2's founders, with Brain.compose(..., memory_choice=True) and the founder key: is the per-state accuracy of the taught chain after 80 episodes alone, through live and through step, at or above the dense founder's when the episodic memory's pattern separator is sparse (memory_fan_in 4 or 2)?
scope: component prerequisite behavior in a fully observed world; a memoryless stage-aware policy solves it, so it tests no memory

sensory.note: the dense founder: the observation keys the records, memory_fan_in 0; reading 2's sensory recipe, its lives reused (see analysis.control)

sparse4.note: the same with memory_fan_in=4: each of the 1,024 code neurons reads 4 of the place key's 7 sensory neurons and 4 of the context key's 12

sparse2.note: the same with memory_fan_in=2: 2 of 7 and 2 of 12

correct_then_step.note: continues from its twin's taught brain and seam

grade_then_step.note: continues from its twin's taught brain and seam

natural_then_step.note: continues from its twin's taught brain and seam

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window

withdrawal: the acquired life resumes from its seam with the caregiver gone and learning on; at each checkpoint it stops at a seam, a frozen copy is read, and the same life resumes

evaluation.note: frozen copies with their own action stream; per-state reading of every stage from a reset copy, greedy, plus 300 sampled draws per stage for the memoryless prediction; one greedy episode, since every greedy episode from a reset reads the same deterministic answers

seeds.note: reading 2's founders, reused: they are needed for nothing else, and the dense founder's lives on them are reading 2's

analysis.unit: founder; a pair is one arm on one founder, sensory recipe against a sparse recipe
analysis.gate: for each of the six arms: sparse minus sensory in per-state greedy accuracy after 80 episodes alone, founder-paired; a sparse recipe meets the drift design when the upper end of every interval is at or above zero
analysis.report: per-state accuracy after teaching and at 10, 20 and 40 episodes alone, founders with every stage right, frozen sampled and greedy success at each reading; within each recipe the live and step continuations as the drift design pairs them
analysis.control: The sensory recipe's readings are reading 2's (protocol-cortex-keys-*.json, sensory recipe, the same compose, arms, founders, streams and evaluation; library 88f9d81, whose founder key is byte-identical to the library under test). Before the sparse runs, the sensory recipe is rerun here under the library under test on a declared subset (screen founders 202001 and 202025 on every view, P1 founder 1001, drift founder 1001); every reading and trained-state digest must equal reading 2's, or the sensory recipe is rerun in full before any comparison.
analysis.verdict: a sparse recipe passes the reading when it meets every screen view, P1 and the drift design

fan_in_note: The setting in question is memory_fan_in=16 against the dense founder. These witnesses have 7 inputs and 5 actions, so the place key has 7 neurons and the context key 12, and the library refuses a fan-in above a key's width; a code neuron cannot read 16 of 7. The reading tests the sparse separator on these keys at two declared fan-ins below their width, 4 and 2, each against the dense founder. A fan-in of 16 reads 0.1% of 12,824 inputs; neither arm reaches that sparsity, and the separation-quality evidence covers wide keys.
